display_name: DURA 源频域回归七景测试
description: 冻结 DURA，以源 IQ 拟合四组噪声条件化广义线性复频域残差。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU2 FP32 TF32off deterministic analytic source fitting; CPU ground

data.representation: frozen candidate + frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on fixed Phase1 seven-view ground IQ
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout, previously seen in other source views
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Recovery training uses paired source IQ only; no F outputs, F weights, TX labels, V or target. Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after recovery checkpoint frozen.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA; four sets of complex ridge coefficients fitted once on 32768 source IDs x three views
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA source-only; source context exact ordered fit IDs and no F/TX/V/target; true checkpoint no-query smoke
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original DURA and source IQ source-only, no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Binned frequency regression selected from source holdout only; all legal fit IDs used once; no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 only; wait for >=4096 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps; preserve all other jobs
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent CPU subprocess ground score after seven complete predictions

rows.method: Four source-noise-bin widely-linear complex spectral DURA residual
rows.purpose: Complete mandatory seven-view Phase1 test and paired DURA comparison
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source IDs 2026110611 and evaluation 2026092701; closed-form deterministic fit
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views
rows.budget_ref: 168000 physical records x seven views batch8; independent truth-last

notes: Source-only global and four-bin regressions were compared on disjoint physical source IDs; four-bin selection precedes this candidate ground evaluation.
One fixed ridge fit on 32768 legal source IDs x three views; no F/TX/V/target data used to fit or select.
Inference uses received IQ and frozen DURA output/variance; no clean, true labels or target adaptation.
Source IQ NMSE is not identity accuracy. Lowest-noise group showed a majority of individual source records worsening.
Fixed epoch-0 analytic checkpoint then mandatory 168000 x seven Phase1 ground views with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and independent truth-last.
GPU2 queue counts all compute apps and waits while 3 or more exist; preserve other jobs.
